concerns.text: T013 (held-out test instance generator) and T014 (data writing) are listed as implementation tasks, but T015b (validation gate) is marked [X] (complete) and depends on the output of T013/T014. A validation gate cannot exist before the data it validates is generated. T013 and T014 must precede T015b in the execution order.

T039a (Implement retry logic) is listed as a separate task after T011 and T012 (the generators). Retry logic is an internal implementation detail of the generators, not a post-hoc task. If T011/T012 are implemented without retry logic, they fail the spec's edge case requirements. T039a should be merged into T011/T012 or T011/T012 must explicitly state they include retry logic.

T022 (parity_checker.py) is a utility required by T023 (training loop). T023 is marked [X] (complete) but depends on T022 which is unmarked. The training loop cannot enforce parity without the checker. T022 must precede T023.

T029 (batch runner) generates the data that T030 (data aggregation) consumes. T030 is listed after T029, which is correct, but T030 is unmarked while T029 is marked [X]. If T029 is complete, T030 must be executable. Ensure T030 is not blocked by missing implementation of T029's output format.

T015 (validation script) and T015b (CLI integration of validation) are split. T015 is unmarked, T015b is marked [X]. T015b implies T015 is complete. T015 should be marked [X] or T015b should be unmarked to reflect the actual dependency state.
